extracted.intended_audience: researchers, institutions, program managers, and other stakeholders interested in ARPA-H funding or collaboration
extracted.subtask_description: Summarize ARPA-H's mission, funding focus, program model, and values that guide selection and management of funded projects. Useful for prospective applicants and partners aligning proposals to ARPA-H priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: deliver high-impact health breakthroughs quickly
rubrics_metrics.description: The Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H) supports the development of high-impact solutions to society's most challenging health problems, delivering health breakthroughs in years, not decades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on accelerating progress — projects should aim for dramatic impact on pressing health problems with timelines that shorten typical translational cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fund research not achievable through traditional or commercial activity
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H advances high-potential, high-impact biomedical and health research that cannot be readily accomplished through traditional research or commercial activity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference for projects that address gaps in existing funding/market incentives or require unconventional approaches/risks that traditional funders or industry won't support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disease-agnostic, broad, intersecting focus areas
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H funds research across four focus areas. These focus areas are disease agnostic, broad by design, and intersect to foster innovation without boundaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals need not be limited to a single disease area; cross-cutting and interdisciplinary work that intersects focus areas is encouraged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program manager-driven ideas and dynamic teams
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H creates an environment to support the best ideas from Program Managers that bring together dynamic teams to solve the toughest health challenges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects are expected to be driven by Program Managers who assemble multidisciplinary teams; applicants should expect collaborator-driven, team-oriented project structures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous program design, competitive selection, and active management
rubrics_metrics.description: Our rigorous program design, competitive project selection process, and active program management ensure thoughtful and impactful expenditures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ARPA-H emphasizes careful program structure, competitive review/selection, and hands-on management throughout the award to maximize impact and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited-term Program Managers to refresh perspectives
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H Program Managers serve for limited terms to ensure a constant infusion of fresh thinking and new perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program leadership turnover is intentional; proposals should align with the Program Manager’s stated vision and be prepared for leadership changes that bring new priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Innovative
rubrics_metrics.description: Innovative — Seek novel ideas, collaborations, and approaches
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects should prioritize novelty in concept, partnerships, or methods; conventional incrementalism is less aligned with this value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Nimble
rubrics_metrics.description: Nimble — Be flexible and urgent, time-bound
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ARPA-H expects agility in execution, rapid decision-making, and clear, time-bound milestones toward measurable outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Responsible
rubrics_metrics.description: Responsible — Maintain highest levels of scientific integrity and fiscal accountability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scientific rigor, ethical conduct, and careful stewardship of funds are required alongside ambitious goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Transparent
rubrics_metrics.description: Transparent — Remain open and honest; engage stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Openness with stakeholders and clear communication about objectives, progress, and failures is expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Bold
rubrics_metrics.description: Bold — Be courageous in goals and approach; be undaunted by the potential for failure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ARPA-H tolerates risk and potential failure when pursuing ambitious, transformational goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Diverse
rubrics_metrics.description: Diverse — Represent a myriad of geographies, expertise, and experiences
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Teams and projects should include diverse perspectives across geography, disciplinary expertise, and experience to strengthen innovation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with HHS policies and reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: ARPA-H follows policies set by the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and responds to reporting requirements set by HHS, Congress, and the White House.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awardees and programs must adhere to applicable HHS policies and be prepared for reporting and oversight by HHS, Congress, and the Executive branch.
